title: The Tech Lab
summary: Research one project at a time. Select the Tech Lab to pick one.
text:
The **Tech Lab** runs research, one project at a time. Select it to see the project under way, then tap **Research tree** to pick the next.

Each project costs alloys (some isotopes too) and takes a while. Technicians working at the lab speed it up. You can cancel a project and get its cost back.

Research does three kinds of thing:

- **Unlocks** new buildings and units (the Fusion Cell, the Shield Projector, the Launch Gantry)
- **Improves** what you have: more mining, bigger batteries, tougher buildings, more drones and units
- **Learns**: some projects end with a discovery of their own

The lab draws a fair amount of power: keep it in your night budget.
